releaseNotes: Network Engine & VPN Tunnel Deactivation Fix: Completely eradicated ghost VPN tunnel and persistent system key icon bug. Closing VPN now immediately releases the Linux kernel TUN file descriptor, terminates tun2socks lwIP loop cleanly, and stops START_STICKY auto-resurrection.
Universal Process Purge: Safely cleans background heavy memory hogs while safeguarding active games, Game Nuke services, and screen recorder tools.
Universal Kernel Touch Listener: Multi-source libwandev.so auto-deployment across all Android 11+ devices and custom ROMs without external unzip dependency.
Macro Studio Pro Overhaul: Fully functional Drag/Swipe vector flick, sustained Hold, rapid 2X Double-Tap, multi-action Combo sequence, and periodic Auto-Retry.
Header UI Disambiguation: Resolved duplicate play icons with dedicated Edit/Test and Arm/Standby controls.
Sub-Millisecond Sensi X/Y & Macro Studio: Red Corner 1:1 hardware evdev grab with safety-net watchdog timer & zero-latency multi-touch routing.
Professional UI & Esports Strings: Sleek, professional UI copy and universal exception shielding across all system services.
